title: The Last Letters Revisited
author: Zephyrine Dravenmoor
blurb: Emrys Almeida, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
